task_contract.operator: Centered NumPy default FFT2 on axes0/1, y_c=M F(S_c x). inverse uses 1/16384 scaling; AH helper sums conjugated-map IFFT without applying mask; not Euclidean adjoint on arbitrary unmasked data. Native stored complex parts float32 become complex128. Coil-last.
task_contract.reference_role: Late explicit source/mask/evaluator rules only; no source truth image or private target bundled.
task_contract.regularization: No explicit lambda or Tikhonov term; CG normal equations, no preconditioner. Zero initial guess, rtol1e-5, atol0, maxiter10*n=163840, info discarded; final magnitude normalized by maximum.
